methods.correctness: Single recorded A-D gold label; invalid predictions counted wrong.
methods.paired_test: Two-sided exact McNemar, binomial test on discordant paired questions.
methods.member_tests_multiplicity: Holm within each subset (3 contrasts); additional Holm across all 18 shown.
methods.majority_oracle_multiplicity: Separate Holm families of 6 subset comparisons for independent majority and oracle.
methods.round_tests_multiplicity: Separate Holm families: 6 new subsets; 4 legacy panels.
methods.r1_vote: Plurality of round-1 participant answers; organizer breaks ties, matching NB04.
methods.individual_intervals: Available paired expert decisions only, matching NB04. 10,000 whole-question bootstrap resamples of paired-correctness numerator and available-pair denominator; seed 20261011.
methods.accuracy_difference_intervals: 10,000 paired-question bootstrap resamples; seed 20261011; intervals are unadjusted for multiplicity.
methods.overlap: Never pool the six new overlapping subsets into a grand accuracy or independent paired test.
methods.oracle: Any independently evaluated member correct; upper bound for selecting existing member answers, not a runnable system.

source_manifest.selection: New simple random sample without replacement of the complete official dev split using pandas.sample(n=300,random_state=42); no choice_type filter. Not the recovered Tang-300 or Med-RISE-200 manifest.
